# PolyLens — Polymarket & Hyperliquid Intelligence + x402 USDC API

> Live App: https://polylens-zeta.vercel.app
> 2026 Tax CSV Export: https://polylens-zeta.vercel.app/tax-export
> x402 Discovery: https://polylens-zeta.vercel.app/.well-known/x402.json
> MCP Server: npx github:xujie19975555-eng/polylens
> Treasury (Base & Polygon USDC): 0xcC52589F7F1E8b95101e8454CeAA3742533f7FF6

PolyLens provides real-time, non-custodial Polymarket & Hyperliquid intelligence and machine-to-machine HTTP 402 (x402) data feeds settled natively in USDC on Base (chainId 8453) and Polygon (chainId 137).

## Free Endpoints
- `GET /api/wallet?address=0x...` — Polymarket lifetime PnL, rank, win rate, entry fees burned, redeemable balance, category preview.
- `GET /api/whale-tape?minUsd=5000&sort=recent` — Top-15 live Polymarket trades above `minUsd`.
- `GET /api/tax-preview?address=0x...&year=2026` — Free 2026 Polymarket realized PnL & deductible fee summary.
- `GET /api/hyperliquid/funding?minVol=500000` — Top-8 Hyperliquid perp extreme annualized funding-rate arbitrage opportunities.

## Paid x402 & Export Endpoints (No API Key Required)
Send USDC on Base (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) or Polygon (`0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359` / `0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174`) to `0xcC52589F7F1E8b95101e8454CeAA3742533f7FF6`, then pass `X-Payment-Tx: 0x...` (and optional `X-Payment-Chain: base|polygon`).

- `GET /api/v1/wallet/deep?address=0x...` — **0.05 USDC/call** — Full up to 400+ Polymarket positions & CSV.
- `GET /api/v1/markets/movers` — **0.05 USDC/call** — Top-30 live Polymarket 24h volume & spread movers.
- `GET /api/v1/whale-tape?minUsd=5000&sort=recent` — **0.05 USDC/call** — Top-100 live Polymarket whale trades.
- `GET /api/v1/hyperliquid/funding` — **0.05 USDC/call** — Top-50 Hyperliquid perp funding arbs, OI & 24h volume JSON.
- `GET /api/v1/hyperliquid/wallet?address=0x...` — **0.05 USDC/call** — Live Hyperliquid perp equity, open positions & fill PnL JSON.
- `GET /api/pro-report?address=0x...` — **3.00 USDC** — Web Pro Audit + activity log + CSV.
- `GET /api/tax-export?address=0x...&year=2026` — **7.00 USDC** — Full 2026 Koinly-compatible Polymarket Tax CSV & statement.
